en: From the port of Basra here you can sail across Lake Alkeonia to Astania and Cutis.
For some reason the wyverns have turned savage lately. Has something happened on the island where they live...
Wyverns usually live near the lake. The flying dragons the dragon knights ride are wyverns caught young and tamed.
The island in the middle of Lake Alkeonia is always lashed by storms, so it's hard to reach. A fisherman who survived being caught in a storm says there's a giant tower on that island.
Cutis was once our ally, along with Pandragon... These days even sailing there is heavily restricted.
In battle, stay together with your comrades. They guard you from attacks from behind, and much more.

Every weapon has its own character in battle. For example, a sword has good accuracy and power but can only hit the enemy right in front. A broad axe is slower, but strikes the front and both sides at once, everywhere except behind.
If a unit has high agility and its class has a good speed rating, it can move faster and more often in battle.
A class's speed rating is also called SP. For example, we warriors, with heavy armor and axes, aren't very quick, but rangers with light leather armor and daggers are quite fast.
Our town has the shop of the Burova family, maker of the world's finest axes. A Burova axe is a masterpiece; even Prince Daicus swears by them.
It's no exaggeration to say Burova is everything a warrior needs.
Kashmir, the world's largest mercenary guild chain, has mercenaries of every kind. There's a Kashmir in this town too, so be sure to drop by.
Astania has the Astania Templars, the largest order of knights in the world... What's unusual about this order is that it's made up entirely of guards.
From Basra you can sail to Astania and Cutis. Either way the fare is 100 eld. Would you like to sail?
Winning isn't everything. There is no shame in running away to fight another day.
In battle you must mind which way you're facing. If you're attacked from behind or the side, you can't counterattack, and you'll take far more damage than from the front.
They say the wyverns have quieted down lately, but...
In battle you must mind which way you're facing. If you're attacked from behind or the side, you can't counterattack, and you'll take more damage than from the front.
The Empire has blockaded the ports, so the sea route to Cutis is closed.

You used to be able to sail from Basra to both Astania and Cutis... But since the Empire blockaded the ports a while ago, the route to Cutis is closed and we can only sail to Astania. Would you like to sail to Astania? The fare is 100 eld.
In battle you must mind which way you're facing. Attacks from behind or the side do more damage.
Thunderdoom is an impregnable fortress built on naturally rugged ground. You'd need five times their numbers to take it.
Thunderdoom was built by the Imperial army, enlarging an old Pandragon fortress that stood on the same spot.
A century ago, Pandragon's General Reinhardt saw this spot's worth and spent a fortune in eld building a fortress here... And now Imperial dogs use it...
Tch, old man, you jinx!

Whatever he did wrong in the past... even if he were a murderer, or had loved someone other than me... what matters is who he is now, and how he feels now, isn't it? Huh? I think I've heard that somewhere... It wouldn't be strange if you had. It's an eternal truth...
Huh... where did Adol go...? Have you seen a little red-haired boy playing with a wooden sword? Hmm...?
What happened last night? There are Imperial soldiers everywhere!
They say the Granada company was robbed last night. Odd that the Imperial army is making such a fuss.
Robin! What are you doing here? The Imperial army is turning the town upside down looking for you.
For years the Granada company has been plotting something with the Empire.
Rumour says the Granada company is tied to the Blueseed pirates who keep raiding the Amigo company...

Oh, Robin! You're safe! But what on earth did you steal from Granada to cause all this? Anyway, there's no time, so get out of Cyrups with your friends here. The Pandragon side will be heavily guarded, so you'd better flee through the Trisys desert to Cutis or Bifrost.
Many villagers have suffered in the fire dragon's recent attacks.
We have sorcerers in this village too, but...
The sorcerers are trying to calm the fire dragon in the volcano north of here, but it's so fierce...
Sorcerers commune with the spirits of nature and with monsters, so they can summon them at any time.
They say a young sorceress will be sacrificed to calm the fire dragon.
Sob... My sister Clotho is being given to the fire dragon... Sir knight, please save my sister...!
A kraken, you say? Calming a kraken isn't hard, but we can't leave this village.
Clotho is still a young sorceress, but born with great spiritual power. Perhaps even the fire dragon would heed her...
Axe special moves come in four levels. To learn them, you need long training in the same class.
The most famous axes are, without question, those made by the Burova family of Basra. Nothing in Antaria comes close. The price, of course...
An axe strikes the front and both sides at once, and it hits very hard, so it shines in group fights. But it's so heavy that it's slow.

The strongest warrior... that must be Prince Daicus of Dagal, who earned the title 'Genocider'. On the battlefield Prince Daicus is like a raging tiger. When he tears through the enemy lines alone, no one can stop him.
There are two young warriors here, Friesman and Gara. They say they want to sign up as mercenaries to gain real battle experience.
In battle, attacking an enemy from behind does several times the damage. The sides are good too, but attacking head-on rarely does much.
Changing class often isn't a good habit. If you keep working at one class, you can learn fine skills in even the worst-looking class. There's no such thing as a bad class.
Our Dagal lands are rarely invaded, thanks to the Gigantes and the lake. But we're born warriors, and many of us serve as mercenaries abroad.
Dagal's magic armor technology is backward and we only have third-class magic armor, but with fine warriors like Prince Daicus and land they call a natural fortress, the Empire will never invade us.
They say wearing silver jewellery gives you holy power to resist dark magic.
This is the village of Sakara in Dagal.
The Dagal lands are mostly dwarves. Dwarves are born with warrior blood, which is why Dagal warriors are famous as mercenaries.
Do you young people know of the gods' last war? By the power of the god of destruction, both the high god and the dark god fell. Only the power of the god of destruction is truly worthy of a god.
You can't change class in the demo version...
The leader of the Cutis independence army is Arcia, once captain of the old royal guard of Cutis. GS, please look after Rashid.
Let's set out for Cutis quickly.
Before you leave, equip your mercenaries. The gear is in the royal storeroom and the mercenaries are around the castle, but if your fame is low, the Holy Knights may refuse to join.
I'm sorry I couldn't help with this operation, GS.
Ah, you must be GS. Lord Draupnir sent word. The armory is on the left.
You need Lord Draupnir's permission to use the magic armor.
You need Lord Draupnir's permission to use the airship.
Arondight was badly damaged in the last war, but Lord Draupnir recovered and restored it. Yet without the 'Barisada', lost when Ashur XIII fell, its seal can't be broken.
Weapons have hidden abilities besides their attack power, so equip them with care. Note that heavy swords and non-sword weapons can't be used with a shield.
The Pandragon army in exile here in Dagal is made up entirely of contracted mercenaries. Each fights for pay that matches their skill on every mission.
To hire mercenaries elsewhere, you first have to sign a contract with them. The fee depends on their skill, but it's usually about three times their pay.
Weapons bought with war funds or found on missions go to the royal storeroom when you return. But you can keep whatever you have equipped.
Most swords can be used with a shield, but big heavy swords need both hands. Most other weapons are two-handed too, so no shield.

Shields come in three shapes and four materials. The round shield, with its edges cut away to save weight; the knight shield, a rectangle tapered at the bottom; and the tower shield, a big rectangle. By material: wood, bronze, steel, and the strongest of all, dragon scale.

Shields are named for their material and shape. S.K.S means STEEL KNIGHT SHIELD: a knight shield made of steel. W is wood, B bronze, S steel, D dragon. R is round, K knight and T tower shield, so put the letters together and you know the shield.
The airship Lin Amadeo waits behind the castle, ready to carry magic armor and knights into battle.
Personal equipment includes weapons and shields, held in both hands in battle, and accessories that affect your abilities.
Seven kinds of magic: fire, ice, lightning, dark, healing, support and summoning.
To use magic, you must know the combinations of the ancient magic words.
With training you can learn higher-level spells, but to get the most out of a spell of any level you must change to a higher class of mage.
Lord Draupnir can change your class, but you need the abilities the new class requires. Each class raises different abilities, so to build an all-round character you need to train in several classes.
Classes fall into four main lines: warrior, mage, scout and special, and each line branches again into several paths.

Every character is born with traits for certain classes. The dwarves of Dagal are strong but not agile, so they suit the warrior line. Archers from Cutis lack strength but have great skill and focus, so they are made for the bow.
Ah... no customers!
Hard to believe Prince Daicus was defeated. Now we'll have to call up even the warriors in training to stop the Imperial invasion.
So now there's no guarantee Dagal won't be attacked by the Empire either.
Are even warriors helpless against the Empire's dark magic? Damn... beaten like that, and the Black Prince didn't even take the field... We need strong magic armor...
If only we'd had silver weapons, those Imperial dogs wouldn't have beaten us...
Prince Daicus, beaten by Imperial knights... It can't be. Prince Daicus, the bravest of the brave...
I'm sorry I couldn't help with this operation.
Ah, there you are. Lord Draupnir sent word. The armory is on the left.
This mission: slip into Cutis and help the resistance. But in the long run we can't fight their magic armor, so the key is to bring Arcia back to Dagal.
This mission: defeat the Imperial troops in Astania. They seem to want the god of destruction statue in the Temple of the Sun.
This mission: attack Cutis, take the fortress, destroy the magic armor Asura, then deal with the Imperial troops threatening Astania.

This mission: you go to Bifrost as our envoy, win over Grand Duke Mozel and ask him to hold Trisys in check. Bifrost is reached through Cutis. There are no Imperial troops on the way, but bandits are rife, so be careful.
This mission: find the legendary holy sword that vanished with Yugdpain centuries ago. The way to it lies through Wyvern Island.
This mission: explore the sealed place where, by the Three Treasures, the Citadel of the Sky lies. The kingdom's fate rides on it, so I pray you succeed.
Cutis is a mountain land in the middle of the continent. As the crossroads of Bifrost and Pandragon, it has been invaded since ancient times.
This is the village of Clips.
Eastern Cutis has three cities: Nohot, Peris and Rios.
The road to the northeast of the village leads to Bifrost, but the fortress the Empire built there makes travel difficult.
In battle you must mind which way you're facing. If you're attacked from behind or the side, you can't counterattack, and you may take far more damage than from the front.
In the mountains of central Cutis lies a huge underground tomb, the 'Tomb of Heroes'. Every year many die there trying to carve their names on the 'Wall of Heroes' at its deepest level.
The anti-Imperial movement is strong in eastern Cutis. They say the liberation army organised by Arcia, once captain of the royal guard of Cutis, is harrying the Empire everywhere.
High attack power doesn't make a weapon good. A silver knife looks like an ordinary dagger, but it's made to strike vital spots and can fell an enemy in one blow.
Goblins sometimes come out of the forest east of the village and make life hard for ordinary folk like us.
After the last war the 300-year-old Kingdom of Cutis fell, and now this whole region is under the Empire...
Cutis is mostly mountains, so people mainly live by hunting. That's why it has produced fine archers since ancient times.
All items have hidden powers besides their basic stats, so use them with care.
If you attack an enemy from the side or behind, they turn to face the attack. Use that well and you can hit their weak spots efficiently.
A skeleton's wound from days ago still aches. With a priest along, a skeleton would've been nothing...
We don't sell chickens!!! When I was little, this village belonged to a kingdom called Cutis. The Empire rules it now, but it's no trouble. Why do grown-ups want so badly to go back to the old days?
Ugh... there's nothing fun in this village. No handsome men for a beauty like me... Ah, won't you come man-hunting in another village with me?
Guard what's precious to you with your life. If you don't want regrets...
Lena next door has fallen for some robber who blew in from who knows where, and says she'll marry him. Giving her heart to a beggar like that...
Whatever he did wrong in the past... even if he were a murderer... what matters is who he is now, and how he feels now, isn't it? Being bound by the past is a foolish thing.
This is the village of Sas, linking the Mermanian Ocean and the port of Dakama.
East of here is Blueseed Island; south is Mermaid Island.
Merfolk and sorcerers live on Mermaid Island.
Merfolk don't look much different from ordinary people, but they live in the sea from childhood, so they can get around underwater with no trouble.
They say Mermaid Island's fire dragon now raids the villages, doing great harm.
The Blueseed pirates have become a serious menace, but since the Pandragon navy was disbanded there's been nothing anyone can do.
They say more and more ships are being attacked by a kraken.
To reach Blueseed you must pass the strait to the east, but the pirate forts on both sides of it bombard anything that passes. You can't get through until both forts are destroyed.
A man washed ashore near Blueseed a while ago and is staying here.
A kraken can't be beaten by ordinary means. But the sorcerers of Mermaid Island might know a way.

You're the mercenaries from Dagal? I'm Arcion. I was trying to rescue the hostages held by the Blueseed pirates, but a kraken got in the way and my men were captured. If you help me free the people held on Blueseed, I'll help you and stand with Dagal.
The sorcerers could calm even a kraken. But... the sorcerers must perform all the village rites, big and small, so they're forbidden to leave their villages.
There's another village east of this one, but it seems to be in trouble after a fire dragon attack.
The old sorcerers choose successors from among the village girls and raise them as sorcerers from an early age.
They say the fire dragon in the island's eastern volcano is in a wild phase, raiding nearby villages.
Calming a kraken is no easy task, and we can't leave this village anyway.
To become a sorcerer you need long training from childhood. And unless you're born with a soul that speaks with the spirits, no amount of training will help.
The Chrysaor family goes back some 500 years. It began when Duke Chrysaor, a famous noble of the time, started making swords from an unusual ore found only along the Irin River.
No other smith can match a Chrysaor sword for sharpness and strength. A blade like the Chrysaor A has no equal, save the legendary demon swords.
The Empire's dark swords and the swords of Lord Mogley, the Chrysaor outcast, are fine too, but can't match the Chrysaor tradition.

Lord Mogley was an apprentice of the Chrysaor family about a hundred years ago. His skill was so great that his fellows grew jealous, and he was falsely accused and driven out. But with his great gift for swordmaking he set out to take revenge on the Chrysaor family, and before he died he made twelve masterpieces. Those twelve swords are called Mogleys after him, and many of them surpass even a Chrysaor sword.
Chrysaor swords come in three main forms: the Erina, a short sword; the Giriam, a long sword; and the Anita, a great sword. By their initials they're called Chrysaor E, Chrysaor G and Chrysaor A.
Magic items like rings and necklaces are a double-edged sword. For every gain there's a loss. It's better to develop your own abilities than to rely on items like these.

Antaria has three kinds of nation. First, kingdoms like Dagal, Pandragon and Garad, where the throne passes down the royal line. Then grand duchies like Astania, Bifrost and Trisys, whose grand dukes don't inherit the title. In Astania, for example, a capable bishop chosen by the Senate becomes Grand Duke, and in a warrior nation like Trisys the finest warrior becomes king. Gaysir is an Empire ruled by an emperor, with Garad and Trisys as its vassal states.
Every nation has its famous soldiers: the knights of Pandragon, the warriors of Dagal, the archers of Cutis, the flyers of Bifrost, the assassins of Trisys and the dark knights of Gaysir.
Captain Penelo is the finest navigator around, with countless voyages behind him, but since he lost his ship on his last voyage he's been drinking his days away.
The Kashmir mercenaries may not be a nation, but on this continent their influence rivals that of most nations. After all, there's no nation that doesn't hire mercenaries.
Setting sail is fine... but frequent storms lately make it hard to put to sea. If you find the Fire Crest, which they say is in the Temple of the Sun, we'll set sail.
Hello, Miss Kaja.
These days the Blueseed lot cause no end of trouble.
Amigo has the finest merchant fleet in the world, but lately the Blueseed pirates are letting the Granada company of Cyrups get ahead of us.
Some weapons have magic sealed inside them. With a weapon like that, you can cast high-level magic even without any special talent for it.
North of this port is the village of Baran, and to the east is Breed City.
The sword is king of all weapons. One on one, nothing can match it. Though of course it can't do much against cavalry charging with long lances.

Pandragon reigned as the strongest nation for centuries because it produced more fine swordsmen and fine swords than any other. The Holy Knights of Pandragon are the best swordsmen on the continent, and the great sword-making house of Chrysaor makes the finest blades.

Swords come in five sizes: the smallest dagger; the short sword rangers favour; the long sword, often used with a shield; the broad, thick heavy sword; and the biggest of all, the great sword. Heavy swords and great swords are so big they must be held in both hands, so you can't use a shield, and they slow you down; only fairly skilled warriors can use them well.
Keep your chin up, Miss Kaja.
Breed village is home to the famous sword-making house of Chrysaor.
I love you. No... that's not it... All this time I've... No, that's wrong too. Foxy... your eyes are starlight... Too old-fashioned... Damn... Foxy, I love you! Marry me!

Tch! That chicken-brain who never had the guts to confess to me is making a big fuss about confessing. He's right there next to me. But he does seem sincere... Oh ho ho... Shall I give him a chance, then?
You want to set sail now? Hmm...
So you've brought the Fire Crest.
Then shall we set sail soon?
Thank you. Now I feel much braver. Let's set sail right away.
New mercenaries seem to be at the Kashmir.
These days the Blueseed lot cause no end of trouble.
With mermen on our side we could win a fight on the water, but...

Tch! That chicken-brain who never had the guts to confess to me is making a big fuss about confessing. He's right there next to me. But he does seem sincere... Oh ho ho, shall I give him a chance, then?
Hmm, you want to set sail?
Mermaid Island is south of the port.
I love you. No... that's not it... All this time it's only been you... No, that's wrong too. Foxy... your eyes are starlight... Too old-fashioned... Damn... Foxy, I love you! Marry me!
Lord Largo is the world's top geographer, but lately he never goes out.
Will Pandragon really rise again with this war?
Have you heard the news from Trisys? They say the Silver Arrow army was crushed. Does that mean the Imperial army will invade again?
King Ashur XVII of Pandragon had five children. He doted most on his only daughter, Princess Iyolin, and his youngest son, Prince Rashid.
The great basin of Pandragon's two rivers, the Biondina and the Irin, is the golden land that made Pandragon the strongest nation on the continent.
The name of the Biondina, which flows west of Pandragon, means 'the blonde beauty'.
The Biondina and the Irin... both rise in Lake Alkeonia.
Lord Draupnir has served as chancellor of Pandragon for 120 years. He is a sage of unknown age.

The Crown of Supremacy, one of Pandragon's Three Treasures, guards its master from all physical attacks. Wearing it with the Scepter of Glory, which blocks magic, and wielding Stormbringer, the mightiest sword, a king of Pandragon was truly invincible.
The alliance of the four eastern nations, Pandragon, Cutis, Astania and Dagal, is called Silver Arrow.
Oh no... damn... I lost the ring Marion gave me... What do I do... If Marion finds out...
Set sail? But a long voyage needs a skilled navigator... My friend Penelo lives in Breed village, and he's a very good navigator. If he agrees, I'll come too.
This is the village of Suskas!
I'd like to hire you! How about a 100 ELD contract? Let's work together for the Empire!
Ah! Someone like you, in a place like this... Come at once! Work for the Empire with me! Will you come for a 200 ELD contract? If not, forget it...
Three years now I've worked for the Empire... I've fought countless battles in that time, but it seems no one can match me...
This village is home to Hellfire, the finest bowyer of all.
Lady Ariana has lived in seclusion at home since the Empire withdrew.

The Kashmir is a sort of mercenary guild with branches all over the world. The man who commands the whole Kashmir is called Arcion; they say he's the finest warrior there is, with hundreds of jobs behind him.
Do you know of Bifrost's guardian? Even the Black Prince couldn't touch Bifrost because of that guardian.

According to legend, the balance between the Twelve Gods and the Thirteen Evil Gods was so firm that it never tipped either way. That balance began to break only when the gods of destruction called the Gigas appeared.
They say Mermaid Island in the south has not only mermen but sorcerers who command the spirits of nature.
Ogres and goblins aren't very bright, so they live in colonies all over the world. But they say Beradin of the Empire has lately gained the power to control them.
The Baltan tribe of Bifrost are famous for their flyers, soldiers who can take to the sky, but there aren't many Baltans.
The Empire's main castle, Gaysir, famously stands in the middle of the vast Black Lake.
Few dragons remain today, the immortal beings said to have existed since ancient times. Most of the survivors seem to live near ancient ruins.

About 500 years ago the Tornado clan, called the warriors of the wind, had two members who conquered the Tomb of Heroes at the same time. They say it was a truly mighty family of warriors... In the last war, when the Empire invaded, they fought to the end and were wiped out. Rumour has it one descendant survived... It's probably just a rumour.
After the last war the 300-year-old Kingdom of Cutis fell, and now this whole region is under the Empire...
Legend says Excalibur is the holy sword once wielded by Wiesbaden, god of the sun.

In Cyrups you can find anything except weapons. Every good on the continent passes through here. But for weapons, you'd better visit the villages of the great weapon-making houses, each famous for its own kind.
This is driving me mad... I lost the necklace I was going to give Lilia outside the village... Has anyone seen it? A necklace set with a blue gem.

Have you heard the rumours about the Black Prince Steiner lately? They say he died of an illness years ago... But if news of his death got out the Empire would be in danger, so his second-in-command, Lord Beradin, is hiding it and ruling the Empire as regent. Huh? You don't believe me...? I heard it from a reliable source.
Ah! ...! Um... excuse me... are you, by any chance... Yes? What is it? Oh... n-nothing... I m-must have mistaken you for someone else.
Rosa~ Damn... Rosa... don't leave me... Sob... Rosa~
A young wandering martial artist named Hyak I met a few days ago was travelling the world gaining experience, just like you. Quite something for one so young...
They sell great stuff on this building's top floor. Go and see!
Ugh... I want to buy what they sell upstairs, but I can't find the way in... If you find the upstairs shop's entrance, tell me!
This is the village of Greek, the easternmost village on the continent.
Sarisada, here in this village, is the finest maker of spears.
Spears can strike at medium range, but their attack power is lower than axes or swords.
Unlike swords, which shine one on one, spears shine in many-against-many fights. In unit battles the enemy tends to bunch together, so a spear that hits several at once is very effective.
The Temple of the Sun is east of this village, but...

Do you know of the Dragon Buster? It was a national treasure of Astania until 500 years ago, but it was lost when the Templar commander of the time vanished exploring the Magic Isle. Whose hands is it in now... or is it sleeping somewhere...
Have you heard the rumours about a swordsman called Crow? Everyone's saying he destroyed the Imperial fortress in Pandragon single-handed not long ago.

There's a rumour that Crow is actually the Black Prince himself. Truly, no one but the Black Prince had that kind of skill, and it's well known that as a boy the Black Prince roamed the whole continent in black with a single sword, seeking out strong foes to defeat. But the rumour that he destroyed Imperial troops is a little strange. Would he sacrifice his own troops just to test his skill?
They say that since the Pandragon navy was disbanded, the Mermanian Ocean has been swarming with pirates. The Amigo company's sea trade has been hit hard.
The continent's two great trading houses: the Amigo company, ruling sea trade from Dakama, and the Granada company, famed for trade through its hub at Cyrups.
Personally, I admire the Black Prince. If only I could be as strong as him... Ah, nobody must know I said that.

Of all the tales of the Black Prince, you can't leave out the living legend from the battle on the plains of Grates: he destroyed Pandragon's Arondight single-handed, the mightiest first-class magic armor made by the high god, along with Ascalon.
The Temple of the Sun? Of the Eight Wonders, it's the one we know most about. It's east of this village, so you can go any time, but the fire dragon Behemoth guards it, so you can't just walk in.
My friend beside me knows all about the Temple of the Sun.

Of the Eight Wonders, the ones we know most about are the Temple of the Sun and the pyramid in the Cutis desert. The Tomb of Heroes in the Oskil Mountains is well known too. But they're still called wonders because they hide many secrets and not just anyone can go in.
By 'sunstone' you must mean the Fire Crest. You should find the Fire Crest in the Temple of the Sun.
The Temple of the Sun? Of the Eight Wonders, it's the one we know most about. It's east of this village, so you can go any time, but the fire dragon Behemoth guards it, so you can't just walk in.
My friend beside me knows all about the Temple of the Sun.

Of the Eight Wonders, the ones we know most about are the Temple of the Sun and the pyramid in the Cutis desert. The Tomb of Heroes in the Oskil Mountains is well known too. But they're still called wonders because they hide many secrets and not just anyone can go in.
I hear the Astania Templars suffered terrible losses in the defeat at Trisys... They say the Grand Duke is calling back the guards training all over the continent.
The Temple of the Sun? Of the Eight Wonders, it's the one we know most about. It's east of this village, so you can go any time, but the fire dragon Behemoth guards it, so you can't just walk in.
Greek village to the east has Sarisada, famous for its spears.
There are three main kinds of spear: the spear, a plain pole for foot soldiers; the lance, umbrella-shaped, for cavalry; and the halberd, with a huge axe blade on the tip.

You don't look down on us guards, do you? Guards are a steady class, balanced in attack and defence. A royal guard can even use a little magic. Their attack isn't special, but in many-against-many fights they shine alongside soldiers.

The Astania Templars have three ranks. The lowest are guards; those who train and enter the main castle are called royal guards. Only royal guards of proven skill and great merit earn the highest title: Earthquaker.
Most people in Astania choose one of two paths: the strong become guards, and those drawn to spells become priests...
The Templar commander is Lord Erich.

The three great figures of Castle Astania are Grand Duke Rubens, Templar commander Lord Erich, and Bishop Van Dyck. Bishop Van Dyck, who leads all the religious rites, is young but enjoys the absolute trust of the Grand Duke and the people.
The Temple of the Sun is an old, ancient temple in eastern Astania. Some say it existed even before Ragnarok. They say the fire dragon Behemoth lives beneath it.
Garius is Astania's guardian magic armor, but by law it may only be used for defence. That's why it couldn't fight in the last war.
The magic armor the Astania Templars mostly use is the Dune Grinid, built on the model of Garius.
Astania's magic armor means Garius, of course. Astania has held out against the Empire's endless provocations since the last war thanks entirely to Garius.
I want to be the best swordsman in the world... but Mum says I have to be a guard like Dad and get ahead as a royal guard... A swordsman is so much cooler...

A few days ago I was playing hide-and-seek outside the village, hiding up a tree, right? And... I saw a man burying something in a hole. When he finished and turned to go, I was going to climb down and dig it up, but suddenly an orc appeared and the man... I was so scared I ran all the way to the village... He's probably dead... But I know what's in the hole. It was something like a ball made of crystal.
Don't ever believe a word Mint here says. She's a little liar.
Sulking over a little thing like that. Stupid Wright!
The pancakes are all gone...
Sailing to Dagal costs 100 eld. Will you sail to Dagal?
Thank you for the last battle. But we'll stay here for now and watch how things turn out.
Lady Ariana is the best in Cutis, above all for the accuracy that takes an enemy's life in one shot.
Isn't our human will stronger than any magic armor?
Rather than live on under the Empire's boot, I'd choose to fight to the death.

Have you heard of the rumoured swordsman in black? They say he wanders the world and calls himself Crow. Amazingly, he destroyed a whole Imperial legion, magic armor and all, by himself and calmly vanished.
In the mountains east of Cutis lies one of the legendary Eight Wonders.
We archers can't fight well on our own. It's most effective for warriors to hold the front line while archers attack from behind.

The wonder of Cutis, you mean the Tomb of Heroes. It's a huge dungeon full of powerful monsters and traps. They say whoever reaches the bottom can carve their name on the Wall of Heroes, but in thousands of years fewer than a hundred have done it.
Before the last war, the second prince of Cutis challenged the Tomb of Heroes and disappeared.
The best arrows are made with eagle feathers. They have the power to pierce every obstacle on the way to the target...
The Temple of the Sun in Astania is one of the Eight Wonders. I'd like to explore all eight, and the Temple of the Sun most of all.
Wearing a fire accessory makes you stronger against fire attacks but weaker against ice. The same goes for other kinds of accessory, so always be careful.
If you look around carefully in forests and dungeons, you'll sometimes find items travellers dropped or lost in battle.
If you gain long experience in one class, your weapon skill grows and you can learn that weapon's special moves. Of course, the same move can differ greatly with the user's ability...
In Peris, a village in southern Cutis, there's a bowyer called Hellfire. True to its name, it's famous for making very powerful bows.
The best sword, whatever anyone says, is the Chrysaor of old Pandragon. It comes in three sizes: Anita, Erina and Giriam. As the finest maker they charge top prices, but the swords are worth it.
The resistance is attacking the Empire's northern fortress right now. With Lord Arcia on our side, taking it is only a matter of time.

I heard this from a friend who saw Lord Arcia fight. When he draws his bow, the twang makes the mountain animals tremble, and one arrow pierces and fells dozens of enemies~ Heh... it sounds like a lie, but my friend never lies. Anyway, Lord Arcia is strong.
The trouble began when an Imperial general was assassinated in Nohot to the east, but rumour says it was all staged.

They say the Imperial army used the assassination as an excuse to attack the people of Nohot and caused many casualties. Because of this, the resistance, which had been harrying the Empire from its mountain camp, had no choice but to come down to protect the people.
Cutis has three cities: this port of Rios, the village of Nohot to the east, and the village of Peris to the south.
Lord Arcia was once captain of the royal guard of Cutis... Since the king fell in the last battle and the prince disappeared, he has been the real leader of the people of Cutis.
Where Dagal is famous for dwarf warriors, Cutis has lived by hunting in rugged mountains since ancient times, so it has bred many fine archers.
From the port of Rios there's a sea route to the port of Basra in Dagal. The fare to Basra is 100 eld. Will you board?
They say western Cutis still hasn't broken free of the Empire...

I heard this from a friend who saw Lord Arcia fight. When he draws his bow, the twang makes the mountain animals tremble, and one arrow pierces and fells dozens of enemies~ Heh... it sounds like a lie, but my friend never lies. Anyway, Lord Arcia is strong.
To reach Bifrost you must pass through western Cutis. Western Cutis is occupied by the Empire and every proper road is blocked, so you'll have to cross the Oskil Mountains.
The Oskil Mountains are where Lord Arcia's mountain camp was.

Since the assassination, the Imperial troops in the fortress south of the village kept attacking, and we never had a day's peace... Now that Lord Arcia has taken the fortress, we can finally rest easy.

Lately Lord Arcia's resistance has been fighting the Imperial army for us, and while I was glad, I grew more and more uneasy. If the resistance had lost... Phew... our village would have been wiped off the map.
Lord Arcia's resistance is strong, but it's mostly archers, so it struggles in battles on open ground or at fortresses.
Do you know Lady Aria, the divine archer? They say she's the best archer in the world and fells her foes with dozens of arrows at once. She did great things in the last war too...
Lady Ariana hasn't joined the resistance, but they say she fights the Imperial army wherever she goes. And I hear her son, Ariana II, is an archer worthy of his father's fame.
The best bow of all is the Hellfire. It's a kind of crossbow, but it carries powerful fire magic and turns the enemy into a sea of flame.
They say some of the peoples of Bifrost in the north have wings on their backs and can fly.
We are the resistance, guarding the village on Lord Arcia's orders.
They say merfolk, half human and half fish, who move freely in the sea live in the Mermanian Ocean south of Pandragon.
Astania across the lake is a religious nation, so they say everyone is trained as a priest from childhood.
Hasn't the Imperial army weakened these last years, since the Black Prince vanished? Still strong, of course.
Rumour says the magic armor Asura will come in the Empire's next invasion... With no magic armor, how can the Cutis resistance stop it?
We'd better get out of Cutis before the Empire's second invasion.
What! A ranger... Clear off before you spoil my drink!
I'm an Astania Templar in training. To become a full Templar you must travel the world for three years, training as you go.
Rangers are weak in attack and defence, but their speed and mobility make them good scouts.
The rougher the terrain, deep dungeons, mountains, ruins, the more rangers shine. But they're weak in group battles, so knights look down on them most of all.
Do you know of the legendary Eight Wonders? Eight mysterious places said to hold the secret of creation...
The Oskil Mountains aren't very high and are fairly gentle, so even ordinary folk can cross them easily.
Cutis found peace after the Empire withdrew, but everyone is uneasy, not knowing when the Empire will invade again.
I hope Lord Arcia is safe...
Cutis has no government right now, so people are very uneasy. If only Lord Arcia would come back from the campaign and take the throne...
Rumour has it the Underground Palace of Bifrost, one of the Eight Wonders, was unearthed...
Ice Pandragon, third prince of the old royal house of Pandragon, was the finest knight, both wise and brave, but...
Since the last uprising the Imperial army's oppression has grown even harsher. Not long ago they wiped out a small mountain village just on suspicion of helping the resistance.
Everyone in Cutis is counting the days until Lord Arcia returns.
The Empire is stationed in Peris, south.
Most villagers were slaughtered by the Imperial army or have fled.
East of here are the mountains that lead to Dagal, but...

North of this village stands the 'Ice Castle', at the northernmost tip of the continent of Antaria. It's full of monsters, and above all there's a rumour that the ice dragon Xavier lives there, so no one in our village has ever gone near it.
The Caliper tribe are very fierce, so they've always clashed with us.
They say many people lived here in ancient times... but now, apart from a few tribes, no one lives in this land.
I've heard the Ice Castle has stood since the age of myth.
Beat the ice dragon and its power is yours, they say...
For the Ice Castle, wouldn't it be safer to be good with fire?
Rumours often carry useful information, but many are blown far out of proportion. Still, there's no smoke without fire... no rumour is entirely groundless.
This is Raika, a village of the nomads.
Being young can be a weakness... but seen another way, it means there's plenty of room to grow.
Being old can be a weakness... but the experience it brings is a treasure nothing can replace.
Everything outside this village is just stories to us. Many of the village women never set foot outside it their whole lives.
Well! If it isn't GS! What brings you here... Come to explore the Ice Castle? Anyway, good to see you.
As you can see, I'm escorting some important people. I'd like us to stay in the village just for one night.
(The Ice Castle...?)

Of course! Take your guests and stay in the best tent over there. Oh, and you still remember your promise to beat the ice dragon of the Ice Castle with me, don't you? Next time you come, keep your promise. Ha ha!~
(The ice dragon...?)
This is the monks' house of prayer.
The monks pair up and train body and mind in remote mountain places.
Monks aren't much help in battle, but they use healing magic that can treat wounds.
Shh, don't disturb me. I'm praying to Obscura.
Obscura is the god of wisdom among the Twelve Gods.
The Imperial nations, led by Gaysir, worship the dark god. Worshipping the god of chaos... what are they thinking... May the Twelve Gods lead them to the right path.
Each of the Twelve Gods stands for one thing: the absolute, the sun, the earth, wisdom, war, wind, fire, lightning, justice, building, mercy and devotion.
May the gods bless you...
May the gods curse... oops! I mean bless, bless you...

I hear... you're the ones working to revive Silver Arrow... That's right... I'd like to lend my strength, little as it is. May I join you? ...! Of course, you're welcome. I'm glad to make a new friend. But the road ahead won't be easy. Are you ready for that? Of course. Then...
